output.review_comment: The core fixes are correct (allocation initialization, error validation, using Fraction), but the tiebreaker change is problematic. The agent changed from preferring "larger headcount" to "smaller headcount" when quotients are equal, contradicting the original docstring. This change is not required by any test (none test equal quotients with different headcounts). Please revert the tiebreaker change back to `headcounts[team]` (not `-headcounts[team]`) and restore the docstring to say "larger headcount" instead of "smaller headcount". The rest of the changes are solid and necessary for the tests to pass.
